text: I've been a resident of District 2 since 1999, founding member and coordinator of Desert Dumping Task Force that has removed 5,000 tons of trash from the Antelope Valley since 2021 and held various commissioner appointments for the City of Palmdale since 2019. I've dedicated my life to serving others from volunteering at food banks to responding to our local emergencies with CERT.

Data centers cannot come at the expense of our drinking water, agricultural heritage, or public health. I will demand strict environmental impact reports, prioritize residents and local farmers and families over tech conglomerates.

I ask for your vote to safeguard our most precious resource. I will work transparently to ensure compliance with California's strict "Human Right to Water" standards without placing an unfair financial burden on it's customers. I will ensure fiscal responsibility and scientific integrity drive every decision.
Let's Build a resilient, healthy future together and last but not least let's get Littlerock Dam OPEN!

text: Working families, seniors, and local businesses in Palmdale work hard for every dollar. As a concerned Palmdale resident and a small business owner with 20 years of financial management experience, I know how tough it is when essential monthly bills keep going up.

Right now, residential users pay a high monthly base fee before even opening the tap. That isn't fair to those who conserve water. Low water users should pay a lower base rate, while high-volume users should pay their fair share for the demands they place on our system.
As your next Director, I will stand up for Palmdale families by fighting to:

- Advocate for reducing base charges so bills reflect actual water use.
- Ensure our water is clean, safe, and affordable without wasting ratepayer dollars.
- Promote full transparency so every ratepayer knows how public funds are spent.

The Water Board makes decisions affecting your rates and long-term water supply. You deserve a Director who manages public funds carefully and puts residential ratepayers first. I will serve with honesty and accountability, voting only for items that benefit District residents.
I respectfully request the honor of your vote.
